evidence.title: Launch HN: Context.dev (YC S26) – API to get structured data from any website
evidence.excerpt: Hi Hacker News, I’m Yahia. I built Context.dev ( https: www.context.dev ) to make it really easy to integrate web data into your products and agents. Here’s a demo video: https: www.tella.tv video build-faster-with-context-dev-api... Since it’s an API, here are the docs: https: docs.context.dev quickstart . You can send us a URL and get back clean Markdown, rendered HTML, screenshots, extracted images, etc.. You can also send us a domain and get company or brand context: name, description,…
